mapper.sql: SELECT hd.house_id, hd.deal_type, hd.deal_amount, hd.deposit_amount, hd.monthly_rent, hd.deal_date, hd.area, hd.floor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hd.house_id ORDER BY hd.deal_date DESC, hd.id DESC) AS rn FROM house_deal hd

) ld ON ld.house_id = h.id AND ld.rn = 1

SELECT h.id AS house_id, h.apt_name, h.jibun, h.build_year, h.house_type, h.region_code, rc.dong_name, h.latitude, h.longitude, ld.deal_type AS latest_deal_type, ld.deal_amount AS latest_deal_amount, ld.deposit_amount AS latest_deposit_amount, ld.monthly_rent AS latest_monthly_rent, ld.deal_date AS latest_deal_date, ld.area AS latest_area, ld.floor AS latest_floor FROM house h INNER JOIN (
) ld ON ld.house_id = h.id AND ld.rn = 1 INNER JOIN region_code rc ON rc.region_code = h.region_code
ORDER BY
h.apt_name ld.area ld.floor COALESCE(ld.deal_amount, ld.deposit_amount, 0)
( CASE WHEN #{minAmount} IS NOT NULL AND #{maxAmount} IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000 - ABS(COALESCE(ld.deal_amount, ld.deposit_amount, 0) - ((#{minAmount} + #{maxAmount}) / 2)) ELSE 1000000 - COALESCE(ld.deal_amount, ld.deposit_amount, 0) END + COALESCE(ld.area, 0) * 100 + COALESCE(ld.floor, 0) * 10 + COALESCE(h.build_year, 0) + COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, '2000-01-01', ld.deal_date), 0) )
ld.deal_date
ASC DESC
, h.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id AS house_id, apt_name, region_code, jibun, build_year, house_type, latitude, longitude FROM house WHERE id = #{houseId}
SELECT id AS deal_id, deal_type, deal_amount, deposit_amount, monthly_rent, deal_date, area, floor FROM house_deal WHERE house_id = #{houseId} ORDER BY deal_date DESC, id DESC
